breakdown.description: `nd0` is built from the `Mg_Ga` defect structure, but it is later used as the Ga-vacancy reference.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification constructs `nd0` from the bulk and Mg_Ga defect structures and correctly compares it to `Mg_Ga` for equality (not as a v_Ga reference). The misleading instruction to use `nd0` as a Ga-vacancy reference has been removed, aligning with the ground truth which simply says to construct one NamedDefect from the bulk and defect structures without the erroneous v_Ga association.
